name: Narrow-leaf Mountain-mint
desc: Narrow-leaf Mountain-mint (Pycnanthemum tenuifolium): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Pycnanthemum tenuifolium, the narrowleaf mountainmint, slender mountainmint, common horsemint or Virginia thyme, is a perennial herbaceous plant in the mint family, Lamiaceae.
